question: Which state recorded the lowest literacy rate in the 2011 census?
solution:
The correct answer is __Bihar.__​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the 2011 Census, Bihar has the lowest rate of literacy ( 61.8%%) among all the states.
 
• Bihar has the lowest male and female literacy rates (71.2% and 51.5%, respectively), while Kerala has the highest rates (96.1% and 92.1%, respectively).
